description: PAID: one web search for $0.0100: send a query, get up to 10 ranked results back as `{query, results[{title, url, snippet}], count, upstream}`. No account and no API key, here or upstream. An upstream that cannot answer is refused without charging you, and a second payment buys a second search. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

limit.description: Results wanted, 1..10. Omitted means 5. Same price.

query.description: What to search the open web for, at most 400 characters, e.g. x402 payment protocol.

name: search_web
title: Search the open web (paid, x402)
